```{python}
#| label: fig-trx-iq-constellation
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "QPSK constellation illustrating the two error contributions. Applied to all four symbols, an amplitude error $\\Delta A$ (radial displacement, orange crosses) and a phase error $\\Delta \\varphi$ (rotation on the circle, green crosses) are shown separately relative to the ideal symbols (blue circles)."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Error magnitudes (exaggerated for illustration)
dA = 0.25              # amplitude error (fractional radial displacement)
dphi = np.deg2rad(20)  # phase error (rotation)

# Ideal QPSK symbols (on the unit circle)
I_ideal = np.array([1, -1, -1, 1]) / np.sqrt(2)
Q_ideal = np.array([1, 1, -1, -1]) / np.sqrt(2)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(5, 5))

# Unit circle for reference
theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
ax.plot(np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta), color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=1, alpha=0.5)

# Axes through origin
ax.axhline(0, color='gray', linewidth=0.8)
ax.axvline(0, color='gray', linewidth=0.8)

# Ideal constellation points
ax.plot(I_ideal, Q_ideal, 'o', color='tab:blue', markersize=10, label='Ideal symbols')

# Apply both errors to all four symbols
angle = np.arctan2(Q_ideal, I_ideal)

# Amplitude error: radial displacement (radius grown by dA, angle unchanged)
Ia = (1 + dA) * np.cos(angle)
Qa = (1 + dA) * np.sin(angle)

# Phase error: rotation on the unit circle (radius unchanged, angle rotated by dphi)
Ip = np.cos(angle + dphi)
Qp = np.sin(angle + dphi)

for k in range(4):
    # Radial amplitude-error arrow
    ax.annotate('', xy=(Ia[k], Qa[k]), xytext=(I_ideal[k], Q_ideal[k]),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='tab:orange', linewidth=1.5))
    # Tangential (arc) phase-error arrow
    arc_theta = np.linspace(angle[k], angle[k] + dphi, 50)
    ax.plot(np.cos(arc_theta), np.sin(arc_theta), color='tab:green', linewidth=1.5)
    ax.annotate('', xy=(Ip[k], Qp[k]),
                xytext=(np.cos(arc_theta[-2]), np.sin(arc_theta[-2])),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='tab:green', linewidth=1.5))

# Impaired symbols (colored to match the error type / legend)
ax.plot(Ia, Qa, 'x', color='tab:orange', markersize=10, markeredgewidth=2,
        label=r'Amplitude error $\Delta A$')
ax.plot(Ip, Qp, 'x', color='tab:green', markersize=10, markeredgewidth=2,
        label=r'Phase error $\Delta \varphi$')

ax.set_xlabel('I')
ax.set_ylabel('Q')
ax.set_xlim(-1.5, 1.5)
ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
